_note: Evergreen editorial seed pool for daily-shit, written by Claude on 2026-11-05 for owner review. Tips, ideas, real tools (homepage links only) and generic opportunities. No news: news only comes from the brand's listed feeds. Edit freely.

items.title: Make the joke obvious enough that it cannot be mistaken for news
items.summary: The label is part of the craft.

items.title: Write a fake headline for each real story you read today
items.summary: Then check which one was harder to believe.

items.title: Label satire clearly so nobody mistakes it for news
items.summary: Good satire is obvious to the reader. If it might fool someone, add a label.

items.title: Punch up, not down
items.summary: Aim at the powerful, the pompous and the absurd, not at people who have little power.

items.title: Record the same segment twice and keep the better take
items.summary: The second take is almost always calmer and clearer.

items.title: Start a weekly show with a fixed three-part format
items.summary: Structure frees you to be spontaneous inside it.
